blocks.text: Splitting a big job into small functions makes code readable and testable. Below, a temperature converter is built from functions that each do one thing.

blocks.prompt: Write `is_leap(year)`: `true` when the year is divisible by 4 but not by 100, or divisible by 400. Print 2024, 1900 and 2000.
blocks.hint: Combine the three conditions with `and` and `or`; use parentheses.

blocks.q: What is the main benefit of small functions?
options: Code is readable, reusable and testable
blocks.why: When each function does one job, it is easy to understand and try on its own.
